transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

I feel drained all the time, like I never have the energy to get through work or even enjoy the things I used to. It just feels like I'm constantly running on empty, and I don't really know what to do about it anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has this low energy and lack of enjoyment been constant, or does it come and go in phases?

I've been feeling this way continuously for a little over two years now, starting around the middle of my second year of college. It doesn't really come and go in phases; it's just been a constant, heavy weight that is always there in the background.
During these past two years, have you had any periods lasting two months or longer where you felt completely back to your normal self and free of these symptoms?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. This heavy, drained feeling has been completely constant over the last two years without any real relief. I definitely haven't had a period of two months, or even a few weeks, where I felt back to my normal self.
Before this continuous two-year period, did you ever have any other times in your life where you felt deeply depressed for a few weeks or months?

No, I don't recall having any other periods of deep depression before this all started during my second year of college. Before that, I generally felt like myself and didn't experience this kind of heaviness.
Along with the low energy, have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns or your appetite during these past two years?

I haven't really noticed any changes in my appetite, to be honest. As for my sleep, I'm not sure if the actual patterns have changed much, other than the fact that I always wake up feeling completely exhausted no matter how many hours of sleep I get.
During these past two years, have you also been struggling with feelings of hopelessness or low self-esteem?

Yes, both of those have been really prominent over the last two years. I constantly feel like a fraud who isn't as smart or capable as my coworkers or classmates, and when I think about the future, I just see a continuous grind with no real hope that things will ever change or that I'll enjoy my life again.
Have you found it harder than usual to concentrate on your work or make everyday decisions over these past two years?

I haven't really noticed any specific problems with concentrating or making decisions. But the constant exhaustion and feeling so drained makes it incredibly difficult just to keep up with my work and classes.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself, or feelings that life is not worth living, during this time?
No, I’ve never had thoughts of hurting myself or ending my life. It's more that life just feels like an endless, exhausting grind, and I honestly don't see any chance of ever enjoying it again.
During these past two years, has this low mood and exhaustion stayed at this same steady level, or did it ever become significantly more intense for a period of a few weeks or more?

It has stayed at a pretty steady level the entire time. It's more of a constant, dull heaviness and a gray filter that never really lifts, rather than coming in severe waves or getting significantly worse. It just remains a flat, exhausting baseline.
